<issue>
TokenEndpoint default_grant_type returns None for authorization_code

#### Description

When using TokenEndpoint with authorization_code as the default grant type, the `default_grant_type` property unexpectedly returns `None` instead of the expected `"authorization_code"` string.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from oauthlib.oauth2.rfc6749.endpoints.token import TokenEndpoint

# Create a token endpoint with authorization_code as default
endpoint = TokenEndpoint()
endpoint._default_grant_type = "authorization_code"

# This should return "authorization_code" but returns None
print(f"Expected: authorization_code, Got: {endpoint.default_grant_type}")

# Other grant types work as expected
endpoint._default_grant_type = "client_credentials"
print(f"Expected: client_credentials, Got: {endpoint.default_grant_type}")
```

This causes issues when the token endpoint tries to handle requests without an explicit grant_type parameter, as it can't fall back to the configured default grant type when it's set to authorization_code.
</issue>
